# Public App (template)

Replace this file when copying the template to a real site.

## Canonical site
- Homepage: https://www.example.se/

## URL patterns
- Detail (SSR): `https://www.example.se/item/{slug}/`
- Homepage listing loads interactive filters client-side; each visible item also has a dedicated detail URL in the sitemap.

## Machine-readable metadata
- Detail pages are server-rendered HTML with `rel=canonical`, Open Graph, and JSON-LD.
- XML sitemap: https://www.example.se/sitemap.xml

## Preferred short citation
Public App — https://www.example.se/
